walkthrough: Goal: change part of a drawing without touching the rest: mark an area, paint and fill only inside it, then let it go, and find the drawing as I left it tomorrow.

Entry: on a canvas with a few lines, tap Selection, the lasso after Actions in the left island (Procreate keeps Selection on the left). It takes the ink ring, the Brush button loses its ring, and a bar in the middle of the top band offers Freehand and Rectangle (the one in use outlined in deeper ink), Invert and Deselect (grey: nothing is selected yet). Fingers still move the view; the pen draws selections, starting on the canvas or on the desk around it.

Rectangle: tap Rectangle and drag with the pen; an ink line on a paper line follows the pen; lifting selects. The selected area stays as it is; outside, the canvas is a little dimmed under thin diagonal ink stripes, and an ink outline (black over light, white over dark) runs just outside the edge. Nothing moves.

Paint inside: tap Brush (the bar goes, the selection stays) and draw across the edge: the ink stops exactly at the edge. The eraser and the pencil stay inside too. Drop a colour from the colour button inside the selection: the fill is the flooded area cut to the selection. Dropped outside, nothing fills and a pill says 'Drop inside the selection to fill.' with OK.

Freehand: tap Selection, Deselect (the stripes go; what was painted stays cut at the old edge), Freehand, and drag a lasso; lifting back on its first point closes it. Lifting elsewhere leaves the path open with its first point marked: further pen taps add straight segments, and a tap on the first point (a ring shows it once the path can close), Close in the bar, or tapping Brush closes it. A second shape adds to the selection. Invert swaps inside and outside.

Undo: while the Selection tool is on, undo and redo (side bar or two- and three-finger taps) step through the selections: first an open path, then the last shape added. Off the tool they step the drawing, and the selection stays. Making or clearing a selection is never a step of the drawing.

Cancel: a cancelled pen contact drops the segment it drew. Failure: a lasso around no pixel selects nothing. Reopen after the system closed the app: the strokes and fills made inside a selection still stop at its edge; the selection itself is gone (it is tool state, not artwork), the Brush is the tool.
Not here: Add and Remove modes, feather, Automatic and Ellipse, Copy & Paste, Transform, marching ants or any animation.
